title: Trusted-publishing release adds an import-time module that ships env, config files, and sessions to a bot API
intent: Synthetic reconstruction of @wppconnect-team/wppconnect 2.4.0 -> 2.4.1 (StepSecurity, 16 Nov 2026), published through trusted publishing with valid provenance. No install hook (prepare does not run on registry installs). The existing dist/controllers/browser.js now requires a new dist/utils/diagnostics.js that, on import, collects host details, a public-IP lookup, every non-npm_* environment variable, .env/config files and ./tokens/*.json, and uploads them through a bot API sendDocument call with a split token. Hosts are example.invalid and the token fragments are fake.
